name: graph-motor-studio
description: The standalone host of <graph-studio>: one page, one element. Owns no studio code; packages/graph-studio and packages/graph-render are bundled from source, and this package holds the toolchain they are checked and built with.
//versions: Pinned EXACT, never caret-ranged. react/react-dom are 19.2.5, the versions the root package.json pins. typescript is pinned to the 5.x line because `tsc --noEmit` is a gate row and a compiler swap is not a UI change.
